title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Fri 13 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast light). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 08:45 to about 16:00. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 4,900 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,100 ft by the Kekoa camera, 200 ft higher than the evening's number; the morning update said about 4,700 ft, off by 400 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,600 ft, off by 500 ft. Most of the day the shear line was at Pukalani; furthest north about 09:37, on Makawao Avenue near Makawao, running toward Kahului; furthest south about 15:22, crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 11 of 53 updates.
